title: CDE / ACC Project Setup Workflow
entry_conditions: The project collaboration environment is being provisioned.
Applicable folder, permission, and baseline-publication requirements are known or explicitly unresolved.

steps.action: Create the governed folder structure required for the project.
Publish baseline files and the associated transmittal note.
Verify access and the resulting audit trail.

governance_notes: The source identifies the CDE Structure Standard and a future Permission Matrix as supporting governance.
This object does not supersede the existing S3 ACC onboarding workflow; reconciliation between generic W1.2 source logic and platform-specific onboarding remains a migration task.

provenance.migration_note: Source workflow W1.2 migrated from the workflow catalogue. Future Permission Matrix remains unresolved.
